sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Bukijutsu, Genjutsu (Auditory), Harmonic Branch

system.description:
You can only cast this jutsu while you have at least one active Doki.

You play a melody forcing your Doki to realize that they are weapons of relative destruction. Select one active Doki. They spend their movement moving as close to a hostile creature as possible. At the end of their movement, if a hostile creature is within range, they can make an attack, targeting them using one of their available attacks. After the attack, your Doki self-destructs, blowing themselves up. All creatures within 20-feet of the Doki when it explodes make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 4d12 force damage.

As part of them detonating, you can spend your Reaction to resummon this Doki.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d12.
